paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism
caption: : The distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, over the WildChat conversations that are matched to online articles from the two identified news agencies.
model_annotation: This chart represents the distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs. The chart is divided into 9 slices, each representing a distinct category. The slices are labeled with their corresponding categories and percentages. The categories and their approximate percentages are: Draft/Other (26.4%, dark red), External News Article (18.1%, green), Press Release (18.7%, yellow), Interview (8.8%, dark blue), Organizational Report (7.7%, light purple), Event Posting (6.6%, pink), Intra-agency news article and Organizational Website (both 4.9%, light blue and purple respectively), Email (2.7%, light green), and Social Media Post (1.1%, orange). The chart does not include a legend, but the percentage labels are positioned outside the corresponding slices. The slices are arranged in a seemingly unordered manner.
